name: Voxel Size Limit
description: Validates that the voxel volume (PixelSpacing × SliceThickness) does not exceed a configurable maximum (reduces partial-volume estimation errors).
implementation:
pixel_spacing = value["PixelSpacing"].iloc[0]
slice_thickness = value["SliceThickness"].iloc[0]
voxel_size_mm3 = math.prod(list(pixel_spacing) + [slice_thickness])
max_vol = params.get("max_voxel_mm3")
if max_vol is not None and voxel_size_mm3 > max_vol:
    raise ValidationError(f"Voxel size should be <= {max_vol:g} mm³. Got {voxel_size_mm3:.2f} mm³.")

testCases.name: 2 mm³ voxels pass when limit raised

parameterDefinitions.name: max_voxel_mm3
parameterDefinitions.label: Maximum voxel volume
parameterDefinitions.description: Fail if the voxel volume exceeds this
